items.title: Courts backlog will fall despite scrapping of jury trial plan, minister says
items.summary: Speaking to the BBC, the justice secretary vows to reduce delays in the system after scrapping plans from the previous government.

items.title: I'm a classic old school Conservative, says Kemi Badenoch
items.summary: The Tory leader seeks to echo Margaret Thatcher as she sets out her guiding political principles.

items.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
items.summary: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

items.title: British Museum announces changes to ease Bayeux Tapestry queues
items.summary: Measures include extended opening hours, as well as an audio guide and additional seating for visitors.

items.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
items.summary: State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

items.title: Daughter of MP murdered five years ago tells BBC politicians still at risk
items.summary: Katie Amess questions if anything has changed to protect politicians five years after her father's death.

items.title: Glastonbury 2027 tickets sell out in 42 minutes
items.summary: Thousands of people joined the queue in the hope of securing tickets to Worthy Farm.

items.title: Why Canada is preparing for an unlikely US invasion
items.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney has said the military is running scenarios in the unlikely case the US invades Canada.
